about_the_game:
Welcome to Don’t Burst My Balloon, a chaotic local multiplayer party game where chickens take to the skies for glory, mischief, and ultimate survival. On Ornithes, a planet ruled by intelligent and magical birds, the rival tribes of the continent of Farm resolve their disputes through the Dominus Aviarium — a contest that pits warriors against each other in airborne duels. Each combatant enters the arena tethered to balloons, their only lifeline, ready to prove which tribe soars above the rest.

Matches are fast, vibrant, and endlessly surprising. Up to four players face off in colorful arenas where balloons keep everyone aloft, and the goal is simple: pop your opponents’ balloons before they pop yours. Every encounter is a balance of attack and defense, weaving between enemy strikes while waiting for the perfect opening to burst them from the sky. Weather conditions transform the flow of battle, items appear with mysterious effects, and unexpected hazards ensure that no two matches ever play the same.

  • Local multiplayer chaos for 2–4 players, perfect for couch play and parties

  • Balloon-based combat where survival depends on bursting, dodging, and outsmarting rivals

  • Diverse arenas with weather conditions and interactive environments

  • Strategic items and hazards that add twists to every round

  • Playful characters inspired by real bird species, with unique personalities and abilities

  • Mini-games and alternate modes that keep the energy fresh and fun

  • An original soundtrack that heightens the frantic, comedic atmosphere

Beyond the core clashes, Don’t Burst My Balloon embraces variety. From high-stakes free-for-alls to tight team skirmishes, the game encourages experimentation and rivalry, spiced up with whimsical mini-games and modes perfect for keeping the party energy alive. Each chicken warrior brings charm and personality to every fight, while elemental skills and smooth controls ensure anyone can join the fun within moments.

Designed to be easy to pick up yet full of depth, this is a game built for laughter, rivalry, and repeat play. Whether it’s with family on the couch or friends at a party, the joy comes from the frantic scrambles, the last-second saves, and the shared chaos of seeing who can stay airborne the longest. Accompanied by a colorful aesthetic and a world brimming with birdly lore, Don’t Burst My Balloon turns every match into a story worth retelling.

So gather your flock, clutch your balloons tight, and discover who will rise as the ultimate chicken champion.
